summary: Wing Yip Food Holdings Group Ltd reported results of its 12th Extraordinary General Meeting held on August 6, 2026, in Seoul, Korea. Shareholders approved two resolutions: (1) authorization to the board to issue new shares, bonds, and other securities, and (2) approval of a private placement of 23,000,000 new ordinary shares at KRW 1,600 per share, totaling KRW 36,800,000,000 (HKD 194,698,693.20) to three subscribers: WANG TINGFENG (13,000,000 shares), WONG SIO CHAN (5,000,000 shares), and ZHAO JIN HUA (5,000,000 shares). Payment due August 6, 2026; shares expected to issue September 7, 2026, subject to Hong Kong registration and regulatory procedures. Proceeds allocated to working capital, marketing, and R&D. New shares subject to one-year lock-up and delivered via Korea Securities Depository. Voted 5,740,816 shares in favor (45.63% of total voting shares outstanding, 100% of votes cast). What to watch: regulatory approval timing and potential overhang from 23 million new shares, representing ~183% of current 12.58 million issued shares.
